Digital Content Producer Enjoyiana Nururdin, M.A. "on-jee-ahna nerd-een" joined WKOW as a Digital Content Producer in March 2024. She is originally from Madison, where she attended La Follette High School and the University of Wisconsin-Madison for her Bachelor of Arts in Reporting. At UW-Madison, she served as the Managing Editor for The Black Voice, a Black-student-led online publication, and as the Student Representative for the National Association of Black Journalists. Enjoyiana was also a food reporter for The Capital Times, featuring local eateries near Madison's campus. She became fascinated with coverage of the 2020 Presidential Election and decided to continue her education in political science and media studies. After graduating from UW, Enjoyiana pursued her Master of Arts in Political Journalism from Columbia University in the City of New York. Her master's thesis highlighted mutual aid efforts in food security and activism in Black and Brown communities. MADISON (WKOW) -- The City of Madison will hold a virtual neighborhood meeting on Tuesday evening to discuss a potential passenger rail station. The meeting will review aspects of the project and review potential station locations as proposed by Alders Marsha Rummel (D6), Amani Latimer Burris (D12), and Dina Nina Martinez-Rutherford (D15). The passenger rail would be an extension of Amtrack Hiwatha Service and it would connect Madison to Milwaukee and Chicago, and then Eau Claire and the Twin Cities. The meeting will run from 6 to 8 p.m. on Zoom. You will receive login information after registering at www.cityofmadison.com/MeetingApril30RailStation . Email questions in advance (optional) to amtrak@cityofmadison.com . For specific questions, reach out to your respective alder. Alder Mike Verveer (D4): Phone: 608-255-6498, Email: district4@cityofmadison.com Alder Marsha Rummel (D6): Phone: 608-772-4555, Email: district6@cityofmadison.com Alder Amani Latimer Burris (D12): Phone: 608-345-8747, Email: district12@cityofmadison.com Dina Nina Martinez-Rutherford (D15): Phone: 608-709-9244, Email: district15@cityofmadison.com You can also contact the Office of the Common Council by email at council@cityofmadison.com or by phone (608 ) 266-4071. title: Council member appeals demolition permit denial
text: In a rare move, Ald. Juliana Bennett is appealing the Plan Commission's recent refusal of a developer's request to demolish three buildings in the heart of State Street for a six-story housing project with commercial space.
